institution_name: Devawongse Varopakarn Institute of Foreign Affairs (DVIFA)

source_register.title: Vision, Values and Mission of DVIFA

institutional_core.mission: Build diplomatic and foreign-affairs capacity, language and communication competence, testing/evaluation capability, research and international cooperation for Thai and foreign officials.
institutional_core.governance: An institute of Thailand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
institutional_core.programme_model: Regular and customised programmes for MFA staff, other Thai agencies, foreign diplomats, civil servants, students and the public.
institutional_core.learning_model: Diplomacy/foreign-affairs training delivered through courses, lectures, seminars, presentations and workshops, combined with language and communication development.
institutional_core.assessment_model: DVIFA operates government-facing English language testing, including DIFA TES, and maintains an evaluation/standards function.
institutional_core.research_model: The official mission includes development as a think tank producing studies, policy recommendations, seminars and publications on strategic foreign-affairs issues.
institutional_core.professional_practice_model: Training targets personnel performing diplomatic, foreign-affairs and overseas government functions across career levels.
institutional_core.international_cooperation_model: Formal MoUs with foreign diplomatic academies and training institutions, plus short-term international training and meeting participation.
institutional_core.credential_model: The reviewed sources document testing and training functions but do not establish a general academic credential model.
institutional_core.digital_transparency_model: Official pages expose mission, organisation, programme functions, testing, leadership and formal cooperation.
distinctive_practices: training for both domestic and foreign officials
